messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: kv-cache eviction rate spike + continuous-batching latency climb in prod cluster eu-west-1. Alert: cache_hit_ratio falling from 98% -> 64% in 10m. Root probe started (2198765432)
Adele: acked. Paging now. I'm oncall for infra, will collect traces. Seen any customer 5xxs?
Customer Success: we already have 2 customers on chat about timeouts, one reports truncated responses. CS opened ticket #CS-4129.
Mike S: grabbing runtime logs. Saw a lot of speculative-draft churn around the same time. Looks like speculative-decoder creating many ephemeral drafts that populate KV with draft keys, then get discarded -> cache pollution.
Jordan: can you paste sample logs?
Mike S: sure. snippet:
```
[2026-03-14T19:02:11Z] request_id=abc123 model=xl-2 spec_mode=enabled draft_id=dr-9a4kv cache_key=kv:pref:dr-9a4kv action=write size=1.2KB
[2026-03-14T19:02:11Z] request_id=abc123 spec_mode=enabled draft_sync=failed target_id=tg-4mlq
[2026-03-14T19:02:11Z] kvcache:evict_score(key=kv:pref:dr-9a4kv)=0.02 -> not evicting (hot)
```
Adele: so ephemeral drafts are being treated as hot prefixes, evict policy not distinguishing draft vs target. That would blow up effective working set.
SRE-Escalation: impact: latency p50->p95 gap increased, token cost up ~1.6x, several tail requests timed out at 30s. Potentially users see chunked or truncated streaming.
opsbot: current system metrics: eviction_rate=3800/s (+8x), batch_merge_failures=17/m, continuous_batch_size_mismatch=high.
Jordan: quick mitigation options: 1) disable speculative-decoding for high-throughput model routing; 2) add TTL tag for draft-prefixed keys and evict aggressively; 3) throttle continuous-batching window for affected pool. Which do we want first?
Adele: short-term: disable speculative for the model in eu-west-1 routing rule. Longer-term: patch cache policy to ignore draft keys unless promoted. Can we push the config?
Mike S: I can flip flag in route config. Executing: `redwoodctl routes update --region eu-west-1 --model xl-2 --set speculative=false`
opsbot: deploy-bot: config update queued, canary started on 3 nodes. (deploy id deploy-219876-1)
Adele: monitor hit ratio and latencies after canary. If canary stable, promote.
15m later
opsbot: canary report: 3/3 nodes OK, hit_ratio recovered to 89% on canary slice. No errors.
Adele: promoting to 20% of traffic.
Customer Success: CS: customers on tickets report improvement in response completeness. One customer still seeing minor tail latencies.
Mike S: promoting to 100% now. Completed. Observed cluster hit_ratio back to 95% and p95 latency back to baseline after 12 minutes.
SRE-Escalation: good. But root cause remains: draft keys marked hot and not being evicted. We'll need a hotfix to metadata tagging + differential eviction policy.
Eng-ML: we have a possible quick patch: when speculative-decoder writes draft keys, also attach `__transient=true` and TTL=30s. That avoids long-lived cache pollution. We can produce a patch for runtime in the next deploy.
Adele: can we do an emergency hotfix for TTL tagging only? That would be lower risk than changing eviction algorithm.
Jordan: I can prepare a small runtime patch: add transient flag toggle behind a feature flag `specie_draft_ttl_v1`. Build+canary should be ~25min. Is that acceptable?
SRE-Escalation: yes do it. Also prepare rollback plan.
Mike S: building patch branch `hotfix/draft-ttl` now. CI started.
20m later
opsbot: ci:build passed for hotfix/draft-ttl. Deploy queued to canary pool.
Adele: apply canary.
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary running (deploy id deploy-219876-2).
Adele: watching metrics. If TTL tagging works, eviction_rate should drop and hit_ratio should stabilize w/out manual disables.
31m after canary
opsbot: canary metrics: eviction_rate down 70%, hit_ratio improved on canary nodes to 97%, batch_coalescing efficiency restored. No errors.
Adele: promote to 100% and keep monitoring.
opsbot: promotion complete.
SRE-Escalation: impact summary to include in postmortem: - customer-facing timeouts: 6 tickets, 2 SLO breaches - additional token cost (estimated) 1.4x for 45 minutes - root cause: speculative draft writes without transient TTL + eviction policy treating drafts as hot - mitigations: immediate disablement of speculative for model routing (temporary), hotfix to attach TTL/transient flag to draft keys, longer-term: cache metadata-based eviction heuristics and opt-in for speculative modes.
Customer Success: noted; we'll follow up customers with timeline and mitigation steps.
Adele: oncall handoff to Jordan for next 12 hours. Please own postmortem and the followup action items: 1) ensure feature flag for TTL is default-on for speculative by next release; 2) add a metric for draft-key-share of cache working set; 3) add alert for cache-hit-ratio drop correlated with speculative write rate.
Jordan: got it, taking handoff. I'll kick off the postmortem doc and link CS ticket IDs.
SRE-Escalation: closing incident thread but leaving in escalation channel for followup.
oncall-bot: Incident closed (resolution: speculative disabled + TTL hotfix). Duration: ~1h 7m.
Adele: thanks everyone. Postmortem action: assigned to @Jordan, @Mike S, @Eng-ML.
